Product Features

  • Wide design for large-screen TVs: With a length of 180 cm, this TV stand offers optimal support for an 80-inch television. Thanks to its 40 x 45 cm footprint, it can be placed against the wall to save space while still filling the entire wall area. It is suitable for living rooms of any size.
  • The high-gloss front panel conveys a premium feel: both the front and top are made of a high-gloss material that gently reflects light and creates an elegant look. Combined with pure white cabinets, it effortlessly underscores the bright and luxurious atmosphere of the living room.
  • LED light strips create atmosphere: Built-in LED light strips give the storage space a special atmosphere when illuminated, and the warm light on the white cabinets transforms the living room into a cozy corner when watching television.
  • Three-tiered, organized storage: The entire unit consists of three levels. The small cabinet on the left is divided into two levels by safety glass partitions, while the right side features three storage compartments. Everything from set-top boxes to books can be neatly organized, ensuring a tidy environment.
  • The freestanding design eliminates hard-to-reach areas during cleaning: The freestanding design prevents dust from accumulating under the hanging cabinet, and daily wiping can be carried out thoroughly, making cleaning much easier for lazy people.
  • Chipboard is robust and durable: Made from high-quality chipboard, it is stable and does not warp easily. It can easily support heavy objects such as televisions and stereo systems and still looks like new even after years of use.
  • The transparent glass partition skillfully showcases the exhibits: The tempered glass partition on the left not only divides the room, but also provides a clear view of the objects inside, making the storage space a visual highlight of the living room.
  • Pure white is versatile and suits various styles: The classic white body of the cabinet blends seamlessly into a variety of interior design styles, such as modern minimalism, Nordic style and light luxury, making it a versatile and beautiful addition to the living room.
  • Smooth opening and closing, easy access: The three cabinet doors open and close easily, so frequently used items are always within reach. Thanks to the concealed design, clutter stays out of sight, ensuring the living room always looks tidy and inviting.
